title: Foiled MCP server config
description: Limits, output caps and origin policy for the MCP endpoint POST /v0/mcp (#24). See docs/mcp/foiled-mcp.md. Mirrors McpConfig in crates/core/src/mcp.rs.

enabled.description: When false the endpoint answers 404 and no tool runs.

destructive_tools.description: Offer reset_sandbox and destroy_sandbox. Both still need confirm: true and a reason.

allowed_origins.description: Browser origins allowed to call the endpoint. Requests with any other Origin header get 403.

calls_per_hour.description: tools/call requests per token per hour, across all tools.

creates_per_hour.description: create_sandbox calls per token per hour.

max_live_sandboxes.description: Sandboxes not yet destroyed, per tenant, before create_sandbox refuses.

max_lifetime_seconds.description: At most the API ceiling of 7 days.

max_bytes.description: Serialised size of one tool result in bytes.

max_string_chars.description: Longest single string kept in a tool result.
